Recurred pantoprazole anaphylaxis: a rare case report from Nepal. Pantoprazole is a commonly used proton pump inhibitor (PPI) with rare incidents of dreaded and life-threatening complications. A 57-year-old woman presented to the emergency department with an acute onset of generalized rashes and chest tightness after intake of an over-the-counter oral pantoprazole and domperidone combination tablet.
